parameters.query:
WITH recovered AS (
  UPDATE marketing.content_items
  SET status = 'queued',
      last_error = 'Reclamacion expirada; el item volvio a la cola.',
      claimed_at = NULL,
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE status = 'generating'
    AND claimed_at < now() - interval '15 minutes'
  RETURNING id
), queued AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM marketing.content_items
  WHERE status = 'queued'
  ORDER BY scheduled_at NULLS FIRST, created_at, id
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
  LIMIT 1
), candidate AS (
  SELECT id FROM recovered
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id FROM queued
  LIMIT 1
)
UPDATE marketing.content_items AS item
SET status = 'generating',
    generation_attempts = item.generation_attempts + 1,
    last_error = NULL,
    claimed_at = now(),
    updated_at = now()
FROM candidate
WHERE item.id = candidate.id
RETURNING
  item.id::text AS content_item_id,
  item.external_key,
  item.pillar,
  item.objective,
  item.audience,
  item.angle,
  item.primary_format,
  item.derived_formats,
  item.premise,
  item.facts,
  item.sources,
  item.warnings,
  item.asset;

parameters.query:
UPDATE marketing.content_items
SET status = 'failed',
    last_error = $2,
    claimed_at = NULL,
    updated_at = now()
WHERE external_key = $1
RETURNING id::text AS content_item_id, external_key, status::text, generation_attempts, last_error;

parameters.query:
UPDATE marketing.content_items
SET generated_content = $2::jsonb,
    status = $3::marketing.content_status,
    generation_model = $4,
    generated_at = now(),
    claimed_at = NULL,
    last_error = NULL,
    updated_at = now()
WHERE external_key = $1
RETURNING id::text AS content_item_id, external_key, status::text, generation_attempts, generated_at;
